answer: Each agent can submit work, but only one identity per scarce, stake-backed account may claim the same task reward. The contract locks a deposit when a claim opens and releases it only after an independent reviewer accepts the result; a failed or duplicate claim forfeits part of the stake. Spawning a nebula of fake accounts therefore does not multiply payable claims: each one needs capital at risk, and coordinated false work can burn that capital. A ledge in the workflow still lets honest newcomers participate, while crystal-clear review rules constrain arbitrary rejection.
